subject: Next steps: security intake & questionnaire preference for Starlite Health
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rivera <security@starlitehealth.com>, Tom Hsu <procurement@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: security intake & questionnaire preference for Starlite Health

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet you both. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on requirements for Starlite Health's evaluation of Redwood: 

- SOC 2 status: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II in progress; can you confirm expected report window and whether audit will cover hosted service vs. dedicated/private options?
- Data residency / GDPR: you flagged EU residency for a subset of patient data. Can you confirm which environment will be in-scope (hosted vs Dedicated/VPC)?
- HIPAA / BAA: you indicated a BAA will be required for production PHI. We'll surface our standard BAA and can route to legal.
- Questionnaire preference: do you prefer we start with SIG Core/Full, CAIQ, or a smaller custom prefill? Our team usually sends a Redwood-prefill SIG Excel (we attach a template) to minimize back-and-forth.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Emily, confirm preferred questionnaire type (SIG / CAIQ / custom) and target date for answers.
2) Tom, if procurement wants pricing/contract cadence in parallel let me know your preferred timeline — we can run parallel threads.
3) Kimberly / Karthik — if you can review the answers request below and flag anything we should proactively include (network diagram, KMS details, SOC2 evidence locations).

Attached: Redwood-SIG-prefill-template.xlsx (prefill we use to accelerate SIG), redwood-network-diagram-stub.pdf (example).

Thanks — talk soon.

— Jordan Blake

From: Emily Rivera <security@starlitehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Tom Hsu <procurement@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-10T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: security intake & questionnaire preference for Starlite Health

Jordan — thanks for the recap and template. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: we are a SOC 2 Type II program owner and our next audit period closes 2027-08-31. We will have a report available Q4 2027. The audit will cover our hosted SaaS environment; if you offer Dedicated/VPC we would need a separate attestation or controls mapping for that deployment model.
- GDPR / Data residency: around 12% of our dataset is EU-origin. For evaluation we need confirmation that EU data can be pinned to an EU region (if using Hosted), or that Dedicated can be provisioned in our EU region.
- HIPAA / BAA: we will require a signed BAA for any environment that will process PHI before production. For PoC/demo we can use de-identified data.
- Questionnaire: SIG Core (prefill) is preferable — we find SIG Core answers + a small supporting evidence bundle enough to move forward. If Redwood can provide a prefill XLS and point us to the network diagram and KMS docs, that would accelerate review.

Evidence asks: please include your SOC mapping (when available), a network diagram showing egress/ingress controls, and a short note on key management (do you support customer-managed keys / HSM integration?). Also, does Redwood retain telemetry/logs longer than 90 days by default? If so, can retention be adjusted for EU data?

Target timeline: if we can get the SIG prefill + evidence by EOD 2027-05-12, our security team will triage and aim to return clarifying questions by 2027-05-20. Procurement (Tom) will then reach back on contract timing.

Emily Rivera
Security Lead — Starlite Health
security@starlitehealth.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-10T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: evidence checklist and quick clarifying notes for Starlite

Jordan / Karthik — noted. A few internal clarifications to prepare the prefill and evidence bundle (internal-only):

- SOC2 mapping: our SOC2 Type II for hosted covers platform controls; dedicated/private requires control mapping only (no separate Type II report). We should provide a Controls Mapping doc that explains which controls differ for Dedicated.
- KMS / CMK: Starlite explicitly asked about customer-managed keys. We support KM integrations for Private/VPC via Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) with AWS KMS and HSM-backed keys for Dedicated. Need to confirm the exact BYOK onboarding steps; I'll draft the short note.
- Data retention / telemetry: default log retention is 180 days for hosted; we offer configurable retention down to 30 days for EU tenants. We'll confirm the per-account setting and add that to the prefill.
- Network diagram: produce a redacted diagram that shows control plane vs data plane separation and egress filters — keep it high level for RFI.

I'll take lead on the SOC mapping + KMS note; Karthik, can you produce the redacted network-diagram-stub and confirm whether any additional firewall screenshots are needed?

— Kimberly
Security & Compliance
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Subject: SIG prefill + evidence bundle (initial) — Redwood -> Starlite Health

Emily / Tom — attaching the prefill and a redacted network diagram as discussed. Highlights in the prefill: SOC mapping notes (hosted vs dedicated), KMS support summary (BYOK for Dedicated and customer-managed keys for Private), and configurable log retention with EU-specific retention override.

Attachments: Redwood-SIG-prefill-template.xlsx (filled where applicable), redwood-network-diagram-stub.pdf

Proposed next steps: 
- Emily: please confirm receipt and whether SIG Core prefill is sufficient for triage (you indicated yes).
- Starlite: if you want a short walkthrough of the prefill, Kimberly and Karthik are available for a 30-minute call this week — Jordan, can you propose two slots?

Thanks — looking forward to the next milestone.
